reasons.text: The label photo is legible and shows model 34785, which is a recalled model, so the model is confirmed.
The date code on the label, 09/2025, falls outside every recalled date code range, so the unit is not part of the recall.
The purchase was from Amazon.com, a listed retailer, dated 2020-02-23, which is inside the sale window. This does not change the outcome.
No other claim shares a photo, address, email, serial number, or payout account, so there is no duplicate flag.
Under the claim policy, a date code outside the recalled ranges is a denial.
